span.p:
C03 POST /api/intakes
LegalIntakeRecordController.create
DTO 검증 · JWT · Idempotency-Key

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LegalIntakeRecordService.create · 트랜잭션
LegalIntake + 자료 종류 + LawyerSearchCondition 저장
응답 id = intakeId · lawyerSearchCondition.id = conditionId

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
C06 POST /api/intakes/{intakeId}/search-requests
createSearchRequest · 문의 접근 권한·최신 조건 확인
AiSearchRequest 저장 · PREVIEW_READY · id = searchRequestId

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
P03 POST /api/intakes/search-requests/{searchRequestId}/execute
SearchExecutionController → SearchExecutionService.execute
실행권 선점 · 작업 큐 · 202 응답

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
run · SearchLlmService.query → 외부 검색
네이버 변협 도메인 대상 + 일반 웹
결과 저장 → 결과별 LLM 관련성 설명

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
C08 POST /api/intakes/search-requests/{searchRequestId}/results
LegalIntakeRecordService.addSearchResult
호출자가 직접 보낸 결과 저장 · 실행 중이면409

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SearchResultSnapshot · searchRequestId로 연결
P03 COMPLETED / NO_RESULTS / PARTIAL / FAILED

div.style: color: rgb(230, 237, 246) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
C07 요청 상세 · P02 문의별 요청 이력
조건 + 정렬된 results를 DTO로 조합
화면이 별도로 조회·갱신
